jobs.occupation: Customer Service Officer: English + Polish OR Lituanian OR Czech - Multiple Shifts - Oostakker
jobs.description:
For our client we're looking for a Customer Service Officer.
In this role, you become the voice of support for drivers facing unexpected vehicle issues across Europe. You'll be part of a fast-paced and multilingual contact center where your communication skills, empathy, and sense of urgency play a crucial role in keeping transport moving.
 

 
• Handle incoming assistance requests from international customers experiencing roadside vehicle breakdowns. 
 
• Take ownership of each case by coordinating with local service providers and technicians until the issue is resolved. 
 
• Maintain constant communication with both the customer and service partner, providing regular updates and reassurance. 
 
• Think on your feet and apply a proactive approach to problem-solving, often finding creative solutions under time pressure. 
 
• Be an integral part of a tight-knit, multilingual team that thrives on collaboration and mutual support. 
 
• Operate within a 24/7 environment, where teamwork and flexibility are essential to ensuring seamless customer experiences. 

- You speak and write fluently in English Czech, and Lithuanian and/or Polish 

 
• Service-driven and naturally inclined to go the extra mile to support customers in stressful situations. 
 
• Strong interpersonal skills help you adapt your communication style to various cultural and professional contexts. 
 
• You enjoy working in a diverse team setting and are always ready to help others succeed. 
 
• Flexibility to work in a rotating shift schedule, including nights and weekends. 
 
• A hands-on mentality with a structured and solution-oriented mindset. 
 
• Eagerness to continuously develop your skills and embrace new challenges.

jobs.occupation: Warehouse worker with CE driving licence - code 95 not needed!
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced warehouse worker or truck driver who enjoys working nights? Do you already in Belgium? And can you operate an electric pallet truck (EPT) and do you have experience moving and coupling trailers? Then this could be the perfect opportunity for you!

For a leading specialist in frozen food transport and logistics, located in Oostkamp, we are looking for a versatile warehouse operator who can act as a truck shunter when necessary. The company is very open to people who only speak English, so you're free to apply if you don't speak Dutch (yet)!

Your responsibilities

In this job, you'll have a highly varied role combining warehouse logistics and yard operations.

Working in the freezer warehouse with an electric pallet truck, you'll:

• Load and unload trucks
• Move pallets between different departments
• Prepare costumer orders
Working in the yard with a terminal tractor (terberg), you'll

• Couple and uncouple trailers
• Move and position trailers around the company's private grounds
• Set and monitor trailer temperatures

Is this your profile?

• ALREADY LIVING AND PERMITTED TO WORK IN BELGIUM
• Experience with an EPT (licence not required)
• Experience coupling and moving trailers
• Comfortable working in a frozen warehouse environment
• Own transportation to the company in Oostkamp (no public transport nearby)
Then please don't hesitate to apply, because this could be your new job!

Nice to have, but not obligated:

• Experience with reach truck
• Experience driving a terberg, tugmaster or other terminal tractor
• Driving licence CE
As you won't be driving on the road, a valid code 95 is not required (but a big plus)!

jobs.occupation: Multi-skilled maintenance technician - English is allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you a hands-on technician who's already living in Belgium? Do you have solid knowledge of electricity or electromechanics? And are you looking for a stable job in maintenance work with lots of variety? Then this might be the job for you!

For a growing transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for a multi-skilled maintenance technician with a strong background in electrical maintenance or electromechanics to help maintain the buildings, warehouse, technical installations, and outdoor areas of the company. And the best part: Dutch isn't required, so you can also apply if you speak English very well!

Your role

As technician, you play a key role in ensuring the reliability, safety, and operational performance of the infrastructure. You perform both the preventive and corrective maintenance of all the facilities, ensuring the logistical operations keep running safely and efficiently. Electricity is at the heart of the job, but you're also responsible for a wide range of general building maintenance.

Your key duties:

• Perform various kinds of repairs, replacements and maintenance works to the infrastructure of the company
• Carry out preventive technical controls on the various installations
• Keep up the company grounds and outdoor facilities
• Help perform maintenance and repairs to the company vehicles
• Supervise external contractors and service providers
You'll sometimes need to go into the freezer warehouse, of course with the necessary thermal clothing.

Is this you?

• Education and/or experience in electrical maintenance, electromechanics or another relevent technical field
• Able to read electrical diagrams and schematics
• Own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
• Very good knowledge of English, both spoken and written
• Already living in Belgium, preferably in the greater area of Oostkamp
Then please don't hesitate to apply, because this job could be yours!

Any other technical skills are a big plus but not required, e.g. mechanics, plumbing, HVAC...

jobs.description:
Our client is a leading Belgian communications and marketing company, with offices in the heart of Brussels and close to the trainstation.

Jobomschrijving

• Manage supplier invoices from receipt to approval and posting
• Ensure correct VAT treatment and support monitoring
• Prepare and process supplier payments on time
• Handle payments through Isabel and ensure proper controls
• Follow up on supplier payment reminders
• Perform AP/AR reconciliations and monitor customer and supplier balances
• Manage bank transactions and financial documentation
• Support monthly closings, audits and annual accounts

• At least a first experience in accounting or finance operations
• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance or equivalent experience
• Fluent in French and English (written and spoken). Dutch is a strong plus
• Solid knowledge of Belgian accounting and VAT regulations
• Comfortable working with ERP systems, payment tools and reconciliation processes
• Autonomous, structured, detail-oriented and proactive
• Strong team player with good communication and prioritization skills

Company

Founded in Belgium in 1935, our client has grown into an international leader in sustainable packaging solutions. Their packaging—from corrugated cardboard and solid board to tubes and protective corners—is produced with recycled paper and is 100% recyclable and biodegradable. With a long-term vision and focus on sustainability, they combine ecological and economic progress. Their products, relationships, and management style all contribute to a greener planet. Today, our client has 6,500 employees, spread across 70 locations in 21 countries. The headquarters is located in Aalst.

For the location in Hoogstraten, our client is looking for enthusiastic operators.

Curious about how paper and cardboard are made? With our client, you will learn it all!

As an operator, you play a crucial role in the production process. These are your responsibilities:
	
• Setting up, operating, and monitoring machines for the production of paper and cardboard products.	
• Starting and stopping machines according to prescribed procedures.	
• Performing quality checks on products during the production process.	
• Ensuring a smooth production process with your colleagues.	
• Performing first-line maintenance on the machines.	
• Reporting technical malfunctions and working with the technical department to resolve them.
Monitoring the safety instructions and ensuring they are applied in the workplace

Eager to learn and interested in growth opportunities? Then you are the operator our client is looking for!
	
• Working in a production environment doesn’t scare you, even if it’s noisy.	
• You are a handy person with an interest in technology.	
• You value safety, order, cleanliness, and quality.	
• You are open to feedback and see it as an opportunity to grow.	
• You demonstrate responsibility and are always ready to help others.	
• You have basic PC skills.	
• You will be employed in a 2-shift or 5-shift system.	
• You speak good Dutch or English.

Company Activities:

Our client is part of the circular economy based on wood fibers. In Belgium, the company has three units employing around 600 employees. The plant in Langerbrugge (Ghent) produces high-quality newspaper and magazine paper from 100% recycled paper. Thanks to two biomass power plants that provide the necessary process steam and three wind turbines, the company is one of the most sustainable enterprises in North Sea Port. Safety is the top priority, and thanks to intensive training programs, employees develop both professionally and personal

• Think pragmatically and solve problems.	
• Plan and organize work effectively, with a focus on achieving results.
